issues.description: The problem statement (and UML) requires the Animal name getter and setter (and the Animal constructor in the UML) to use protected visibility, but the solution implements them as public. This mismatch between the specification and the provided solution can confuse students about the intended access level and whether they should implement protected or public accessors/constructor.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Animal constructor and the getName()/setName() methods use protected visibility to match the problem statement and UML (or, alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to state that these members are public). Ensure the template and solution consistently use the same visibility so students are not uncertain which access level is required.
